Attached: 4 images

We had a great first day at Cloud Native Denmark. Søren Boss Jacobsen is one of the organizers, Gabriele Bartolini ran a #CloudNativePG workshop, Gabriele Rossini talked about #Observability for #PostgreSQL on #Kubernetes, and Josh Lee joined Adriana Villela of Dynatrace for a keynote dedicated to the next generation of cloud native contributors and community maintainers.
